description: Test-only support for Solhigson projects: the census base, the census of censuses, the async test base, the build-rules census (the language version, the SDK pin and the Solhigson.Analyzers rules, read from the package root its build targets write into the test assembly, skipping a dotnet new template's .template.config source), the Roslyn C# source helper, the markup scans, the personal-data census PersonalDataCensusTests, and the Tier=<engine> database test pool (DatabaseTestBase, IDatabaseProvisioner, PostgresProvisioner over Testcontainers) with its tier-trait census DatabaseTierCensusTests.
releaseNotes: 10.2.0: the Tier=<engine> database test pool: DatabaseTestBase<TProvisioner> (one process-wide pool per IDatabaseProvisioner type, the worker count plus Spares databases cloned once from a template, borrowed in a sealed SetUpAsync with a 60 s bound and returned to two dedicated reset threads, a database whose reset throws retired for a fresh clone) and PostgresProvisioner (one Testcontainers container per provisioner type per process on 127.0.0.1 with a random password, a template marked IS_TEMPLATE, a reset by one batched DELETE under session_replication_role replica); a borrowing class carries [Trait("Tier", engine)], and the tier fails without Docker or with Testcontainers' reaper off, never skipping. DatabaseTierCensusTests (rule TIER-TRAIT: every public concrete DatabaseTestBase subclass carries a Tier trait). PersonalDataCensusTests (rule PERSONALDATA-UNMARKED: an entity or DTO property or positional record parameter whose whole PascalCase words name personal data carries [PersonalData]). BuildRulesCensusTests skips a dotnet new template's .template.config source. New dependencies: Testcontainers.PostgreSql 4.12.0, Npgsql 10.0.3, SSH.NET 2026.0.0. A consumer inherits each new census once (explicit base call). 10.1.0: BuildRulesCensusTests, the build-rules census of design K (LangVersion only in a Roslyn component, a root global.json with rollForward latestPatch, the Solhigson.Analyzers switches and reference, .editorconfig lowerings dated by a solhigson-exception comment), reading the packaged rules from SolhigsonAnalyzersRoot, which this package's build and buildTransitive targets write into the test assembly; a consumer inherits it once (explicit base call) and references Solhigson.Analyzers. 10.0.0: first release. CensusTests and CensusRuleAttribute (a census reports its flagged subjects per rule id and the base applies the project's dated solhigson-exceptions.txt), CensusOfCensusesTests (every abstract census of this package inherited exactly once, every exceptions line's rule id declared), AsyncLifetimeTestBase (set-up and a once-only tear-down over xunit v2's IAsyncLifetime), CSharpSource (the consumer repository's .cs files parsed once each through Roslyn, with their invocations and declarations), MarkupScan (a tag's closing '>', a view's inline script body and a form's posted names, over Razor and HTML).
